description: This file defines types and logic for evaluating and validating execution host requests, including security policies, request validation, and approval decision handling within a Swift project.

classes.name: ExecHostValidatedRequest
classes.description: A data structure representing a validated execution command request.

classes.name: ExecHostPolicyDecision
classes.description: An enumeration representing possible decisions regarding execution host requests (deny, prompt, allow).

classes.name: ExecHostRequestEvaluator
classes.description: A static class-like enum providing methods to validate requests and evaluate policies.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates an ExecHostRequest and returns a success or failure result with a validated request or error.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the context and approval decision to determine the policy decision (deny, prompt, allow).
